condition: Assigning through df.iloc/df.loc with a 0-d numpy array key (e.g. np.array(1)) raises TypeError/ValueError/InvalidIndexError on mixed-dtype or extension-dtype frames instead of acting like the scalar key.
workaround: Turn the 0-d array key into a scalar before indexing, e.g. df.iloc[int(key)] = 9 or key.item().
